name: Rosebank
house_style: Delicate, floral, triple-distilled Lowland single malt — soft and intimate, with citrus, orchard fruit, grassy/herbal notes and a creamy, spirit-driven elegance. Long regarded as the benchmark of the Lowland style.
notes: Lowland 'ghost' distillery, mothballed/closed 1993. Acquired by Ian Macleod Distillers in 2017; revived with a new distillery and visitor centre (production resumed July 2024, public reopening 2023-2024). The 'Legacy Series' of limited annual releases drew on casks laid down before closure: Release One = 30 Year Old (1990, bottled 2020, 48.6%); Release Two = 31 Year Old (1990/1991, bottled 2022, 48.1%); Release Three = 32 Year Old (2024). NOTE: a vintage conflict exists for the 31yo Release Two (sources state both 1990 and 1991) — see expression node rosebank-31-r2.

ian_macleod.company_facts: Owned by Ian Macleod Distillers — independent, family-owned (Russell family), HQ Broxburn, founded 1933 by Leonard Russell Snr (family acquired 1963). Rosebank (Lowland 'ghost' distillery, closed 1993) acquired by Ian Macleod in 2017 and revived; distillation resumed July 2023, visitor centre opened 7 June 2024. The Legacy Series of annual limited releases (Release One 30YO 2020, Release Two 31YO 2022, Release Three 32YO 2024) drew on pre-closure casks. Produces >15M bottles/yr group-wide.
